headline: Newly Appointed AI Czar Confirms His First Task Is To Teach Chatbots How To Interpret Sarcastic Indian Mothers
body:
Q: Mr. Chatterjee, your appointment as the new lead for artificial intelligence coordination has raised eyebrows, mostly because you seem to be focusing on a very specific demographic. Why is that?

A: Look, the world is obsessed with Large Language Models, but they are all functionally illiterate when it comes to the nuances of 'If you want to go out, go and live with your friends then.' If an AI cannot distinguish between a genuine permission and a tactical trap, it’s useless to an Indian household.

Q: And this is a national priority? You've already secured funding for a 'Guilt-Tripping Algorithm'?

A: It’s about global competitiveness! If my refrigerator starts lecturing me about my cholesterol levels with the exact tonal frequency of my auntie at a wedding, that is true artificial intelligence. We are moving beyond binary code into the realm of 'Beta, log in properly or don't log in at all.'

Q: How do you plan to train these systems, given that current models are trained on internet data?

A: We are feeding them 40 years of transcripts from family WhatsApp groups and unsolicited career advice. By next quarter, your GPS won’t just tell you to turn left; it will ask you why you chose this route and remind you that your cousin reached the destination fifteen minutes ago.
caption: The new AI task force is focusing on the only intelligence that actually matters: understanding exactly what your mom meant when she said 'nothing' happened. #AI #TechTrends #IndianParents #Satire (satire)
igHook: Would you trust an AI that has been trained exclusively by Indian aunties?
